_comment: Maps the state's document-type codes to the two categories it actually files them under.
The site only exposes a Contract/Purchase Order filter for Higher Education, so on the
agency side the distinction is invisible in the UI even though the records carry it --
about 65% of agency records are purchase orders.
Source: each code's detail page is headed either 'Contracts' or 'Purchase Orders'.
Sampled one document per code (scripts/build_site.py warns if a code appears that isn't
listed here, so a new one shows up as its raw code rather than being grouped wrongly).
CN and PO are the exception: they come from Higher Education searches, where the site's
own DocType filter is authoritative. PO's detail page is headed 'Contracts', which is
simply wrong -- a document returned by a Purchase Order search is a purchase order. That
disagreement is also why the headings are treated as a sampled observation rather than a
